claim_under_pricing: Implementation smoke only: add flagged constant-velocity obstacle kinematics while preserving the legacy static/zero-relative-velocity contracts.

seed_discipline.selection_training_or_validation_reuse: none: this is an env-contract smoke, not training or target pricing

preregistered_readouts.legacy_contract: In moving_crosser_zero_relvel, observation slot rel_vx and rel_vy must remain exactly 0 for every sampled frame.
preregistered_readouts.dynamic_kinematics: In moving_crosser_ego_relvel, active obstacle body-y must change by at least 0.5 m over the rollout on every non-terminal replay that reaches at least 8 steps.
preregistered_readouts.relative_velocity: In moving_crosser_ego_relvel, at least one observed obstacle rel-velocity channel must be non-zero before termination.
preregistered_readouts.determinism: Same seed plus same scripted actions must reproduce observations, active obstacle body pose, termination, and completion fields bit-for-bit within 1e-7.
preregistered_readouts.label_rederivation: Moving crosser scenarios must carry obstacle_lateral_velocity and predicted_lateral_offset_at_arrival in the sampled ObstacleScenario and use those fields in the feasibility label.

decision_rule: Accept B1 smoke iff all readouts pass on the full seed set. Passing admits only the moving-obstacle env axis for future preregistered measurements; it does not admit training or claims.
runtime_gates: quick smoke passes before the full smoke
legacy static zero-relvel smoke still emits zero rel-v channels
moving crosser is behind a non-default obstacle motion mode
deterministic replay passes on the frozen replay seeds
claim_boundary: B1 moving-obstacle implementation smoke only; no training, no driver mutation, no validation ranking, no promotion, no driver-performance, no high-fidelity sufficiency, no paper, no repair-success, no robustness-result, no feasibility-proof, and no self-ID claim.
